    CAST(CAST('2000-04-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATETIME),
    INTERVAL (CASE
      WHEN CAST(DATETIME_ADD(
        CAST(CAST('2000-04-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATETIME),
        INTERVAL (DATE_DIFF(
          CAST(CAST(orders.order_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE),
          CAST(CAST('2000-04-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE),
          YEAR
        )) YEAR
      ) AS TIMESTAMP) > CAST(orders.order_date AS TIMESTAMP)
      THEN (
        DATE_DIFF(
          CAST(CAST(orders.order_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE),
          CAST(CAST('2000-04-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE),
          YEAR
        )
      ) - 1
      ELSE DATE_DIFF(
        CAST(CAST(orders.order_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE),

  FROM orders AS orders
  WHERE
    orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS DATETIME2)
    AND orders.order_date < CAST('2025-07-01 00:00:00' AS DATETIME2)
  GROUP BY
    DATETRUNC(month, orders.order_date)
), _cm_time_spine__returns__amount_sum AS (

    AND returns.return_date < CAST('2025-07-01 00:00:00' AS DATETIME2)
  GROUP BY

), _cm_time_spine__orders__id_count AS (

  FROM orders AS orders
  WHERE
    orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS DATETIME2)
    AND orders.order_date < CAST('2025-07-01 00:00:00' AS DATETIME2)
  GROUP BY
    DATETRUNC(month, orders.order_date)
)
SELECT
  _base.[time_spine___timestamp],
  _cm_time_spine__orders__amount_sum.[orders___amount_sum] AS [time_spine___o],
  _cm_time_spine__returns__amount_sum.[returns___amount_sum] AS [time_spine___r],
  COALESCE(_cm_time_spine__orders__id_count.[orders___id_count], 0) AS [time_spine___n]
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_time_spine__orders__amount_sum
  ON (
    _base.[time_spine___timestamp] = _cm_time_spine__orders__amount_sum.[orders___order_date_month]
    OR (
      _base.[time_spine___timestamp] IS NULL
      AND _cm_time_spine__orders__amount_sum.[orders___order_date_month] IS NULL
